test_ufuncs_single_int: test numpy ufuncs like np.abs and np.sign on IntegerArray with NA values
test_ufuncs_single_float: test numpy ufuncs like np.log, np.exp, np.sin, np.cos, np.sqrt on IntegerArray returning Float64
test_ufuncs_binary_int: test numpy binary ufuncs like np.add and np.subtract on IntegerArray with arrays and scalars
test_ufunc_binary_output: test numpy ufunc np.modf on IntegerArray returning a tuple of two IntegerArrays
test_ufunc_reduce_raises: test np.add.reduce on IntegerArray matches sum(skipna=False) behavior
test_stat_method: test pandas stat methods like var, std, kurtosis, skew, sem on IntegerArray Series with NA values
test_value_counts_na: test value_counts on IntegerArray with NA values, both dropna=True and dropna=False
test_value_counts_empty: test value_counts on empty IntegerArray Series preserves dtype
test_value_counts_with_normalize: test value_counts with normalize=True on IntegerArray Series returns Float64 proportions
test_integer_array_sum: test IntegerArray.sum with skipna and min_count parameters for various integer dtypes
test_integer_array_min_max: test IntegerArray.min and IntegerArray.max with skipna parameter
test_integer_array_prod: test IntegerArray.prod with skipna and min_count parameters
test_integer_array_numpy_sum: test np.sum on IntegerArray handles NA values and empty arrays correctly
test_dataframe_reductions: test DataFrame reductions like max on IntegerArray columns preserve integer dtype
